Can one declared Markov coherence law be represented by a complete horn record rather than only a class-level status claim?

## Claim boundary

The filler concerns finite seam-compatible ordered path amalgamation. It is presentation-level and supplies no physical backend.

For four typed path segments \(A,B,C,D\), the five vertices are the five binary parenthesizations. The pentagon boundary consists of the five elementary reassociations connecting them.

## Filler

All five boundary residuals vanish exactly. The observed residual equals the predicted empty residual. The pentagon filler is the strict identity between the two composite reassociation routes and is unique in the faithful ordered-list coordinate.

This is stronger than observing one loop scalar: every boundary cell is enumerated, its probe is declared, and the filler is constructed.

## Disposition

One degree-four Markov horn now has a contract-complete record. It demonstrates the positive branch of the obstruction tower: complete boundary, vanishing residual, constructed filler, and faithful-coordinate uniqueness. It does not imply unbounded coherence or cross-sector horn filling.
